-- 直近 30 日で sessions 上位 50 URL + origin (TOP page)
WITH top_urls AS (
  SELECT page_url AS url, sessions, 1 AS priority
  FROM `campwill-ec.mart.ec_page_ux_health`
  ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 50
),
with_origin AS (
  SELECT url, sessions, priority FROM top_urls
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'https://ku-bell.com' AS url, 999999 AS sessions, 0 AS priority
)
SELECT url FROM with_origin GROUP BY url ORDER BY MIN(priority), MAX(sessions) DESC
